recent_posts.title: Secure your digital legacy with WordPress.com's 100-Year Domains and Plans
recent_posts.summary: WordPress.com introduces 100-Year Domains and a newly enhanced 100-Year Plan, designed to secure digital legacies for a century. These offerings protect domains and websites from expiration, platform changes, and digital decay. The 100-Year Plan includes special trust accounts, contingency planning, data redundancies, and backups in the Internet Archive’s Wayback Machine, ensuring long-term access and security. These options are ideal for creators, organizations, families, businesses, and future historians who want to protect their online presence for generations.

recent_posts.title: Top reasons your business needs a website today
recent_posts.summary: Businesses need a website to own their online presence, control appearance and functionality, improve search engine visibility, and enhance professional credibility. Unlike social media, a website offers greater stability, comprehensive engagement options, and growth opportunities. WordPress.com provides the tools and support to build a site, regardless of technical expertise.

recent_posts.title: 30 tips to boost website traffic effectively
recent_posts.summary: Increasing website traffic involves consistently applying fundamental strategies. Effective approaches include optimizing for search engines through target audience analysis, relevant keywords, and metadata enhancements. Additionally, optimizing site structure, speed, and acquiring backlinks contribute to higher ranking. Regularly publishing optimized blog posts, leveraging email newsletters, social media tactics, and exploring PPC advertising or SMS marketing can further enhance visitor numbers. Utilize tracking tools to measure success and make informed adjustments.

recent_posts.title: 21 effective tactics to instantly increase your blog traffic
recent_posts.summary: To boost blog traffic, consider implementing a range of strategies related to SEO, content consistency, image optimization, backlink acquisition, email marketing, and social media engagement. Critical tactics include conducting keyword research, creating evergreen content, adhering to Google's E-E-A-T guidelines, optimizing images, and ensuring fast loading times. Consistently publishing valuable content, adding internal links, using SEO plugins, and leveraging email marketing and social media can also significantly increase traffic. Analyzing user data to inform content strategy and maintaining a clean blog design are additional steps to attract and retain visitors.

recent_posts.title: Create a website without coding using WordPress
recent_posts.summary: Learn to create a professional website without coding using WordPress. This guide takes you through setting up website goals, choosing a hosting provider, selecting a domain name, customizing your site's design, adding functionality with plugins, optimizing for search engines, and maintaining the site. Perfect for beginners wanting to establish an online presence.

recent_posts.title: How to Customize Your Bluesky Handle with a Custom Domain
recent_posts.summary: Bluesky, a Twitter-like platform with decentralized architecture, allows users to use a custom domain as their handle for better identity verification and seamless social media management. This guide explains how to connect your WordPress.com domain to Bluesky, streamlining the process of verifying your identity and ensuring organic traffic to your website.

recent_posts.title: WordPress.com's Core Interface Style
recent_posts.summary: WordPress.com has updated its user interface to align more closely with the core WordPress experience, phasing out the custom 'Calypso' interface. The transition aims to offer a consistent and intuitive experience, improve support through standardized resources, and allow the WordPress team to focus on innovation. Users can expect a unified and familiar navigation and settings experience, benefiting from ongoing enhancements for website hosting.

recent_posts.title: How to Start a Successful Blog: A 12-Step Guide for Beginners
recent_posts.summary: Starting a blog is a rewarding and enjoyable experience, allowing you to dive deeply into topics of interest, improve your writing skills, and even build a business. This guide provides a step-by-step process to help you create a blog, from choosing a niche and securing a domain, to setting up and designing your site, and writing and promoting your content effectively. Blogging remains a viable way to attract an audience, drive traffic, and establish authority in your industry.

recent_posts.title: New WordPress themes to revamp your site in 2025

Easily customize and activate any of these themes to fit your website's purpose, ensuring a professional and modern digital presence.

top_posts.title: Studio: Now Available for Windows
top_posts.summary: Studio, a free local WordPress development environment, is now available for Windows machines. It provides a fast and simple way to build WordPress sites locally. The Windows version of Studio allows users to access WP Admin, the Site Editor, global styles, and patterns with just one click. Users can also easily create and share demo sites.

top_posts.title: Comprehensive Guide to Website Layouts and How to Choose the Right One
top_posts.summary: Designing an effective website layout involves understanding various common types, such as Z-pattern, F-pattern, magazine, grid, and more. Each layout suits different types of websites depending on content and goals. Key factors include making a good first impression, leading user attention, and providing strong UX. Using tools to create wireframes can help map out and refine your layout. Ensure your layout is user-centered with a good visual hierarchy and enough white space.

top_posts.title: Creative ways to use forms on your WordPress site
top_posts.summary: Forms on WordPress sites can be used for more than just contact pages. They can collect valuable user information, generate leads, and enhance engagement. Examples include running contests, registering users for events, conducting surveys, growing mailing lists, facilitating job applications, and involving users in product decisions. Tips for effective forms include keeping them simple, minimizing typing, and providing clear instructions.

top_posts.title: Building Studio in Public: Using WordPress Components and Tailwind CSS in our Local Development App
top_posts.summary: The post outlines how WordPress Components and Tailwind CSS were utilized to build Studio, a local development environment for WordPress. It highlights the use of reusable WordPress components and the benefits of customizing them with Tailwind CSS to create a familiar and flexible user interface. Detailed steps guide developers on setting up Tailwind CSS, installing WordPress components, and customizing styles. Studio, being an open source tool, encourages contributions from developers familiar with these technologies.

top_posts.title: Meet Studio: Your New Favorite Way to Develop WordPress Locally
top_posts.summary: Studio by WordPress.com is a free, open source local WordPress development environment that simplifies site setup and workflows. It offers seamless solutions for creating and running WordPress sites locally, as well as sharing work-in-progress sites. Studio is lightweight, efficient, and eliminates the need for complex setups.
